fundamentos_legais.texto_resumido: If a consumer disputes the accuracy or completeness of information in a credit report, the consumer reporting agency must conduct a reasonable reinvestigation and delete or correct inaccurate information, generally within 30 days.
Consumer reporting agencies may not report obsolete negative information beyond specified time limits (generally seven years for most derogatory items).

jurisprudencia.numero_processo: Gorman v. Wolpoff & Abramson, 854 F. Supp. 914
jurisprudencia.resultado_resumido: Under FCRA dispute procedures, furnishers and CRAs must block or remove inaccurate reporting within 30 days after a consumer dispute when the information cannot be verified.
